privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.intro: Ajiya Ta ("mu", "namu") tana da aniyar kiyaye sirrin masu amfani da ita. Wannan tsari an qulla shi ne bisa ga **Dokar Lamba 2017-28 ta ranar 3 ga Mayu, 2017** ta kariyar bayanan sirri a jamhuriyar Nijar da **Yarjejeniyar CEDEAO A/SA.1/01/10**.
privacy.consent: Ta hanyar amfani da Ajiya Ta, ka amince da tarawa da amfani da bayananka bisa tafarkin wannan dokar sirrin.
privacy.identification_list:
• Suna, lakabi ko sakayyar suna
• Imeil da/ko lambar waya
• Tsarin asusu da nau'in kudi (XOF, USD, d.ss)
privacy.financial_list:
• Ayyukan kudi (samun kudi, kashewa, turawa)
• Kasafin kudi, maqasudin ajiya da rukuni-rukuni
• Rasitoci/Bile-bile da aka dauki hoto (da izininka)
privacy.technical_list:
• Nau'in na'ura da samfurin Android/iOS
• Bayanan kuskure da aikin manhaja
privacy.storage_desc: Bisa tsarinmu na "Offline-First", bayanan kudadenka suna adane a kan na'urarka ta kanka.
privacy.encryption: Idan an haɗa da uwar garke ta Cloud, ana rufa bayanka ta hanyar tsaro mai qarfi yayin zirga-zirga.
privacy.biometric_note: Bayanan fuskarka ko yatsanka suna zamanto ne a tsarin tsaro na wayarka kadai, Ajiya Ta ba ta taba samun damar ganinsu.
privacy.rights_intro: Bisa ga dokokin Nijar da na CEDEAO, tana da haqqoqi kamar haka:
privacy.rights_list:
• **Haqqin dubawa:** Ganin dukkan bayanan da suka shafeka.
• **Haqqin gyarawa:** Gyara bayanan da ba dai-dai ba.
• **Haqqin gogewa:** Neman goge bayananka baki daya.
• **Haqqin hanawa:** Qiyar amfani da bayananka saboda wani qwaqqwarar dalili.
privacy.regulatory_desc: Idan an samu sa-in-sa da ba a daidaita ba, zaka iya mika qorafi zuwa **Haute Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (HAPDP)** a Jamhuriyar Nijar.
privacy.contact_desc: Domin Tambayoyi kan wannan manufar sirrin:

terms.title: Sharuddan Amfani
terms.object_text: Wannan Sharuddan Amfani (CGU) suna gudanar da amfani da manhajar **Ajiya Ta**.
terms.acceptance: Amfani da manhajar yana nufin amincewa da dukkan wadannan sharuddan baki daya.
terms.service_nature_desc: Ajiya Ta wata na'ura ce ta gudanar da kudi na kanka da tsarin kasafi. Tana taimaka maka wajen lura da kudaden da ke shiga da fita.
terms.service_warning: Ajiya Ta ba banki ba ce, kuma ba wani wuri ne na biyan kudi ba. Manhaja ce kawai ta lissafin kanka.
terms.obligations_list:
Mai amfani ya amince zai:
• Ba da ingantattun bayanai lokacin saita profile.
• Kada ya amfani da manhajar ta hanyar damfara ko saɓa dokokin Nijar ko na duniya.
• Tsare lambobinsa na sirri (PIN, yatsa/fuska).
terms.liability_text: Ajiya Ta tana ba da taimakon lissafi ne kawai. Bamu da alhakin kuskuren shigar da bayanai da mai amfani ya yi ko asarar kudi da ya samu.
terms.law_text: Wadannan sharuddan suna karkashin **Dokokin Jamhuriyar Nijar**.
terms.jurisdiction: Duk wata sa-in-sa za a mika ta ne ga **Kotu a Niamey**.
